evidence.evidence_boundary: Synthetic volatile fixture runtime and controller/render tree execution only. No browser visual inspection, real account, backend, or production calls.

public_profile_to_register_or_login.expected_hypothesis: A delayed TeacherProfile.openPublicProfile read might leave shared journey.loading stuck or block the new auth form, or overwrite the current route/projection when it settles.
public_profile_to_register_or_login.actual: Four promise-controlled cases (register/login x success/failure) left journey.loading=false throughout. The controller set profile.status=loading, then the epoch guard ignored the stale completion. Register/login forms and submit buttons rendered; submit disabled was false. Current route stayed put. The superseded profile projection remained status=loading in hidden controller state, and public-site rendering did not show it on the auth route.
public_profile_to_register_or_login.assessment: The public-profile shared-loading defect is not reproduced; the profile read does not use journey.loading.

adjacent_directory_search_to_login.expected_hypothesis: An invalidated directory operation may return before clearing shared loading.
adjacent_directory_search_to_login.actual: A real microtask race started public:directory-search for query 'avery' and immediately navigated to login. The search returned {ok:false, ignored:true}; journey.loading remained true and matches.status remained loading. The login form and submit rendered, submit disabled was false, no loading/progress copy appeared on login, and blank public:login dispatch reached local validation_failed while the stale loading flag remained true.
adjacent_directory_search_to_login.assessment: A controller-only stale flag and hidden directory projection reproduce, with no disabled-submit or visible login progress effect.

next_grounded_action: Treat E602 as a falsification of the profile-read hypothesis. H1 is independently probing the adjacent directory race; reconcile its result before choosing any source change. If correcting the adjacent state, bind or clear loading to the active directory request lifecycle and add a deterministic controller test for route invalidation; keep any claim limited to controller state because this probe found no visible auth-form effect.
